title: “A Christmas Carol”
seo_title: A Christmas Carol at Connect2Culture in Joplin, Dec 10
description: This holiday stage production of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol, from CMI Entertainment and Entertainment Central Productions Orlando, follows Ebenezer Scrooge and the ghosts of Christmas Past, Present, and Future. It uses projections, Christmas carols, costumes, and puppetry, and is aimed at audiences of all ages. It is a one-off performance on Thursday, December 10, 2026 at 7:00 PM at Connect2Culture, 212 West 7th Street in Joplin, MO; tickets are $70 plus fees.
